messages:
maria_g: Quick sync — HelixHealth SI (FieldSight) ran into blocked installs during on-prem image pull. They hit two things: (1) private registry cert mismatch, (2) firewall blocking marketplace egress to our signing service. Can @sylvia_se or @devin_ops triage?

devin_ops: seen. Do we have the image digest they used? Could be old signed image key.

partner-eng: FYI, partner confirmed they used the marketplace-provided image URL, but their transit NAT strips SNI. We saw similar w/ customer X last quarter.

sylvia_se: I'm tied up in arch review till 11am PT. If this is blocking go-live, escalate and I can hop on. What's the immediate mitigation for installs?

maria_g: Customer is green to accept a temporary bypass if we supply a pre-signed tarball + checksum for validation. They asked if that breaks our marketplace signing guarantee.

alex_k: Temporary tarball is OK for timeboxed field install if we log the change and set TTL. Need legal signoff? Also ensure KMS key rotation notes.

jordan_pm: Important: this customer's announcement plan references a joint case study next week. We can't delay release without notifying marketing. @maria_g can you loop in marketing?

maria_g: adding @jess_marketing in DM. For now, priority is install. Devin, can you drop the port/egress rules we need? I'll send to their infra team.

devin_ops: required egress:
```
- allow outbound tcp 443 to signing.redwood-inference.com:443
- allow outbound tcp 8443 to registry.partner-marketplace.net:8443
- allow DNS (udp 53) to their resolvers
```
Also they need to allow SNI passthrough — NAT change on their edge.

partner-eng: Confirmed. We'll provide step-by-step to field ops. Also noting their firewall vendor applies deep packet inspection, might change cert handshake.

marketplace-bot: Note: Marketplace signing key rotated 2025-09-02. Docs: https://redwood.cloud/marketplace/signing

sylvia_se: Ok. Plan:
- Devin to provide temporary tarball and checksum before 15:00 PT (today).
- Partner to open inbound NAT change ticket and confirm SNI passthrough.
- I'll schedule a 30m arc review at 16:00 PT if issues persist.

maria_g: Client agreed to tarball. Partner eng — send the install artifact link here once uploaded.

partner-eng: Uploaded to secure-bucket, link sent to client. checksum: sha256:abcdef123456... (will DM full)

alex_k: I'll update runbook and audit log entry. Also we should record this as "marketplace bypass" incident with tag si-field.

jordan_pm: I'll notify marketing and push announcement back if we need more time. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

maria_g: closing loop for now — re-open if install fails after 16:00 PT. thx.
